reference_sql:
SELECT store_code,
       ROUND(SUM(units) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS units_per_line,
       SUM(units) // COUNT(*) AS units_per_line_int
FROM sales
GROUP BY store_code
alternatives: SELECT store_code, ROUND(CAST(SUM(units) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*), 2) AS units_per_line, FLOOR(SUM(units) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) AS units_per_line_int FROM sales GROUP BY store_code
